name: Wells Fargo (credit cards)
notes: Researched from public wellsfargo.com pages only (no sign-in). Home page sign-on form: 'Username', 'Password', 'Save username', 'Sign On', 'Forgot username or password?', 'Enroll' / 'Enroll in Wells Fargo Online', 'Sign on with a passkey'. Payments: Wells Fargo Online / app (same-day payments, future-dated payments), Autopay deducted from the account you choose (no need to add the card), 24/7 automated phone line at the number on the back of the card, and Wells Fargo ATMs. Online payments come from a deposit account (card methods removed; inferred). Paperless: 'Manage Delivery Preferences'; online statements kept 2 years. Due date: Credit Card Service Center > Account Management > 'Change Your Payment Due Date' (29th-31st not allowed). Payment relief: short-term and long-term plans or a due-date change via the Relief Center in the app or 1-800-988-8019 (Mon-Fri 8-5 CT). Closing a consumer card is not described as an online action on the pages used; the card agreement says you close it by contacting Wells Fargo, so cancel_service is unsupported online (inferred) with the 24/7 card line 1-800-642-4720. Autopay amount presets are not published for consumer cards on the pages used, so AutoPay policies stay at the family default. No pay-without-sign-on option (inferred). Review 2026-10-09: sign-on wording, Autopay, Manage Delivery Preferences, 2-year statements, the 29th-31st due-date rule, Relief Center and 1-800-988-8019 re-verified on the cited pages. Account nav labels 'Account Summary', 'Make a Payment', 'Payment Activity' and 'Statements' are generic (inferred); 'Account Management' is from the FAQ.

sources.title: Wells Fargo Bank | Financial Services & Online Banking
Credit card payment assistance | Wells Fargo

guest_pay.note: Wells Fargo has no pay-without-signing-on option for credit cards. Sign on to Wells Fargo Online, use an ATM, or call the 24/7 automated line at the number on the back of your card.

cancel_service.note: A Wells Fargo credit card account is closed by contacting Wells Fargo, not online. Call 1-800-642-4720 (24 hours); you still owe any remaining balance. To stop using the card without closing it, you can turn the card off online.

help.title: Ways to pay your Wells Fargo credit card
paragraphs: Sign on to Wells Fargo Online or the Wells Fargo Mobile app to make a same-day payment, schedule a future payment or manage payments.
Set up Autopay in Wells Fargo Online and the payment is deducted automatically from the account you choose.
You can also make a same-day payment by phone through the 24/7 automated system at the number on the back of your card, or at more than 11,000 Wells Fargo ATMs.

help.title: Online statements
paragraphs: To switch to online statements, sign on to Wells Fargo Online and go to Manage Delivery Preferences.
Online statements can be viewed and downloaded for up to 2 years.

help.title: Change your payment due date
paragraphs: Sign on to the Credit Card Service Center and choose Change Your Payment Due Date under Account Management. Dates from the 29th through the 31st cannot be picked.

help.title: Credit card payment assistance
paragraphs: If you are having trouble paying, Wells Fargo may offer short-term payment options, longer-term payment plans or a different due date that fits your paycheck.
Request relief yourself in the Relief Center in the Wells Fargo Mobile app, or call a payment specialist at 1-800-988-8019, Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central. Not everyone qualifies.

help.title: Credit card phone numbers
paragraphs: 24-hour credit card customer service, lost or stolen cards, disputes and balance transfers: 1-800-642-4720. General customer service: 1-800-869-3557 (24/7). Rewards: 1-877-517-1358.

extra.intent: Using Wells Fargo's help pages, find the phone number for credit card payment assistance specialists. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using Wells Fargo's help pages, find how long online credit card statements stay available to view and download. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Online statements are available for up to 2 years.
